answer_2.quote: We report Word Error Rate (WER) and Phoneme Error Rate (PER) metrics extracted using a pretrained SOTA ASR system ... We also report the BLEU and UER metrics ... We evaluate the F0 estimation model using the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) between ground-truth F0 and predicted F0.

answer_4.quote: Participants were recruited using a crowd-sourcing platform. ... We propose a new subjective metric called Emotion-Mean-Opinion-Classification (eMOC). In an eMOC study, a human rater is presented with a speech utterance ... For the crowd-sourced subjective evaluations we computed the MOS and eMOC metrics.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to rate the audio quality (Mean Opinion Score) and to select the emotion that best fits the speech utterance (eMOC).
